verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is a compliance SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no MCP server or endpoint. The llms.txt, Markdown docs, OpenAPI schema and Postman collection are developer building blocks or adjacent agent-readable docs, not an MCP server. Its own built-in screening and monitoring agents are a different capability and do not let an external agent connect.
